what: When the section center reaches the screen center, the panel is pinned for 3 screens (scrub .1) and small photos and color chips gather around a circle (42% of the panel’s short side) and scatter again — each chip comes in 0→1 at .3 radians ahead of its own angle and settles (1s power2.out, .5 stagger), the circle turns 180° and the chips turn the opposite way by −180° (.5 × chip count + 1, power1.out). When the circle passes 180°, it fires fx:orbit-half (the original changes the background to yellowed paper), and at the end the chips grow 1.4× at double the radius and fade (2s power2.in).

options.radius: Circle radius (ratio of the panel’s short side), default .42
options.lead: Entry start angle (ahead of rest position, radians), default .3
options.out · grow: Scatter radius multiplier · growth multiplier, default 2 · 1.4
options.jitter: Jitter mixed into the chosen angle, default .05
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Square disc (required) — the pieces spin inside it
options.[data-fx-part=pin]: (if any) panel to pin — otherwise the parent of the disc
